STEP 1 - Scene: A salad-style meal of sliced rare-to-medium steak (or similar roast meat) served over arugula and chard, with radish slices.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A large white rectangular/square plate with rounded corners, roughly dinner-plate size, about 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Sliced beef steak (pink interior, seared exterior)
- Arugula (rocket) leaves
- Chard/leafy greens with red stems (mostly stems and leaves)
- Radish slices
- No visible dressing or oil pooling

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, summing to food coverage):
- Arugula: ~28% (upper right, large area)
- Chard leaves and stems: ~17%
- Steak slices: ~12%
- Radish: ~4%
Total food coverage ≈ 61% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume (area x height):
- Arugula: 148 cm^2 x 3 cm = 445 ml
- Chard: 90 cm^2 x 2 cm = 180 ml
- Steak: 64 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 96 ml
- Radish: 21 cm^2 x 1 cm = 21 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Arugula: 445 x 0.15 ≈ 67 g
- Chard: 180 x 0.15 ≈ 27 g
- Steak: 96 x 0.95 ≈ 91 g
- Radish: 21 x 0.6 ≈ 13 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Arugula: 67 g x 25 kcal/100 g ≈ 17 kcal
- Chard: 27 g x 19 kcal/100 g ≈ 5 kcal
- Steak: 91 g x 210 kcal/100 g ≈ 191 kcal
- Radish: 13 g x 16 kcal/100 g ≈ 2 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 198 g and ≈ 215 kcal. This is plausible for a moderate salad with about 90 g of steak on a large plate, with leafy greens being light in weight.
